label: SEC company (one figure per cik, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one company, keyed by its cik (10 digits). Its stored method fact relays one figure as filed, of one annual report (accession) and period; the cells of the class are the figures of the companies in scope.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros

label: Company figure as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one figure as the company filed it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. The unit is the unit as filed (a currency code such as USD, shares, <currency>/shares or pure) and is returned as the unit of the value. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. An instant (a balance) has the same date as period_start and period_end.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the element as filed with its prefix, such as us-gaap:Assets or dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (see the dictionary)
args.unit: the unit as filed: a currency code such as USD or EUR, shares, <currency>/shares such as USD/shares, or pure
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period_start: YYYY-MM-DD, the start of the period; an instant has the same date as period_end
args.period_end: YYYY-MM-DD, the end of the period (for an instant, the same date as period_start)

label: SEC annual report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one annual report (10-K or 10-K/A), keyed by its accession; its six methods are the report's cik, form, filed date, fiscal year, fiscal period and period end, each as filed in the company's submissions record.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The company's CIK (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The form of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the form of the report, 10-K or 10-K/A, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The filing date (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the date the report was filed, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The fiscal year of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the fiscal year of the report (fy), a number in unit 1; it is not the year of the period end for a year that ends in another month, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The fiscal period of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the fiscal period of the report (FY for an annual report), of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The period end of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the period end of the report's annual statements; not a cover-page date, which is later, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
